lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: It's raining inside my house again.

lines.speaker: carpenter
lines.text: Have you tried patching the thatch?

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: It is simply my indoor weather now. I do not question it.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Saw a funnel cloud forming over the ridge. Made lunch instead.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: You didn't run to the cellar?

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: It was a remarkably well-crafted sandwich.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Frost froze my water bucket solid on the nightstand.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Keep the hearth stoked until sunrise.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: My breath is creating its own personal cloud in here.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: The woodpile is looking dangerously thin.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Gather everyone in the Town Hall to share the central heat.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Spring thaw can't come soon enough.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: This downpour turned the main road into knee-deep soup.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Good for the barley, terrible for leather boots.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: I'll be scraping river silt out of my socks till Tuesday.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Snow drifts are piling up against the barn doors.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Grab a shovel before the livestock get snowed in.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: At least the wolves hate wading through deep drifts too.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Ground is cracking open like baked pottery.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: The creek is down to a muddy trickle.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Ration the well water until the clouds return.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: The marsh frogs are screaming in four-part harmony.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: That usually means heavy rain before sunset.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Then they have a better forecasting record than the Town Council.
